summary: Ran live mobile regression at 390x844 and API smoke checks. Home controls load and backend questions, resident creation, capsule creation, and resident capsule reads pass. The create-profile modal cannot expose its submit control within the mobile viewport, blocking the requested UI workflow.

ui_bugs.issue: At 390x844, after filling resident-name-input, resident-create-button is below the viewport and Playwright reports it outside the viewport. The modal content is not scrollable, so profile creation cannot be completed by a mobile tap.

action_items: Make the add-resident modal body/keyboard layout scrollable or otherwise keep resident-create-button within the 390x844 safe viewport.
Align the frontend environment variable with the required EXPO_BACKEND_URL contract, or explicitly document why EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL is used; current source does not read EXPO_BACKEND_URL.
critical_code_review_comments: The modal uses a plain View rather than a scroll container, and its vertical content exceeds the mobile viewport.
api.ts reads EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL and expo extra backendUrl, not EXPO_BACKEND_URL specified by the deployment contract.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_API_* resident and TEST capsule through public API; created TEST Jeanne locally/server-side before the UI blocker interrupted the flow.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Home loaded at https://ehpad-recall.preview.emergentagent.com on 390x844. API GET questions, POST residents (201), POST capsules (201), and GET resident capsules passed. UI run stopped at resident-create-button because the control was outside the viewport; do not treat later workshop/archive steps as tested in this iteration.
rca_of_issue: Reproduction: open home-add-profile, fill resident-name-input at 390x844, then tap resident-create-button. The bottom-sheet modal contains heading, explanatory text, input, consent row, and button inside a non-scrollable View; the button is rendered below the viewport. KeyboardAvoidingView changes height but does not provide scrolling. Mitigation: wrap modalCard content in ScrollView with keyboardShouldPersistTaps, or reduce/position content so the submit button remains reachable above the safe-area inset.
